prompt:
Draw the land borders and coastline of Poland as of 1 January 1938 from memory.

Rules:
- Draw land only. Each separate piece of territory (mainland, island, exclave) is its own polygon. Do not enclose sea.
- Leave out overseas dependencies and Antarctic claims.
- Use at most 400 points in total.
- Your drawing is scored by overlap: the area it shares with the true territory, divided by the total area covered by either. Missing land and extra land both cost you.
- Give your best attempt even if you are unsure. An approximate drawing is expected.

Format:
- You may reason first. End with one ```geojson block; only that block is scored.
- The block holds a single GeoJSON MultiPolygon:
  {"type": "MultiPolygon", "coordinates": [[[[lon, lat], [lon, lat], ...]], [[[lon, lat], ...]]]}
- Longitude first, then latitude, in decimal degrees with at most 2 decimal places. West and south are negative.
raw:
I need to draw Poland's borders as of January 1, 1938. This is interwar Poland, which existed between WWI and WWII.

Key features of Poland in 1938:
- Western border with Germany (including the "Polish Corridor" to the Baltic Sea)
- Northern coastline on the Baltic Sea (relatively short, around Gdynia/Gdańsk area)
- Eastern border with the Soviet Union (much further east than modern Poland, including parts of modern Belarus and Ukraine)
- Southern border with Czechoslovakia and Romania
- Northeastern border with Lithuania

Major geographical points I should remember:
- Baltic coastline roughly between 17-19°E longitude, around 54.5°N latitude
- Western border around 15-16°E
- Eastern border extending to about 26-27°E (much further east than today)
- Southern border around 49°N
- Northern border around 54.5°N
- The country was roughly centered around Warsaw (21°E, 52°N)

The shape was somewhat irregular, with:
- A narrow "corridor" to the sea in the north
- Broader territory in the center and east
- The Białystok region extending northeast
- Lwów (Lviv) in the southeast
- Vilnius was NOT part of Poland in 1938 (it was disputed/part of Lithuania)
